تبتذلين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَذِلِينَ (tabtaḏilīna) /tab.ta.ði.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# تُبْتَذَلِينَ (tubtaḏalīna) /tub.ta.ða.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
